sources.label: Official ellesse size guides (Women's Clothing Size Chart)

audit: Old ellesse.co.uk host timed out; the guide is on ellesse.com. Letters were one size off: stored XS = UK 6, the chart has XXS = UK 6 and XS = UK 8. No hip measurement published, so hips removed. Chest stored as bust. Stored M (UK 10) 88/70/94 -> M (UK 12) 91.5/76; UK 10 is now S at 86/71. 2XL row removed (not on the chart, which stops at XL = UK 16). US row is letters, as printed. 'EU sizing' removed from notes; the 'runs small' wording is left for review.
notes: Italian sportswear brand with strong 80s heritage. Its chart maps letters to UK sizes (XXS = UK 6, XL = UK 16). Slim Italian cut — runs smaller than UK equivalent. Heritage tracksuits and polo shirts especially slim.
